newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Cimpor hits all-time high, nears 4,000 esc.
newsitem.headline: Cimpor hits all-time high, nears 4,000 esc.

text.p: Shares in Portugal's leading cement group Cimpor-Cimentos de Portugal hit an all-time high of 3,800 escudos on the Lisbon bourse and dealers said it could rise to 4,000 escudos soon.
"The rise of shares like Cimpor is linked to the euphoria of the market as a whole. Cimpor is being pushed higher in overall bullish sentiment," said one operator.
Another said: "I think 4,000 escudos can be reached soon."
Cimpor stood at 3,800 escudos, up 113, in volume of 108,506 shares at 1050 GMT.
Another cement producer Semapa also rose in the bullish mood, dealers said. It stood at 3,010 escudos, up 45, in volume of 26,400 shares at 1050 GMT.
"When Cimpor rises, Sempapa follows," said one dealer.
Dealers said Cimpor's interest in acquiring another cement manufacturer did not appear to be behind the sharp rise in its share price.
